tieBreak: explicit confidence, checked date, stable source URL, stable value
notes: Priority selects one published value; it is not a guarantee that every item from a higher-ranked domain is correct.
Reviewed overrides and direct game captures outrank default domain preferences.
A character's acquisition rank is scoped to that character, method and ability. Different characters do not share one threshold.
Distinct acquisition methods, shop locations, recipes and routes remain separate contexts.
Missing values remain missing; the resolver does not extrapolate from other characters or invent acquisition conditions.
